I absolutely love coming back here for dental work. I am a nervous patient, but have returned 4 times now (from Australia). The team does so much to make me extremely welcome and comfortable.
The dental work has been excellent (crowns, fillings and cleaning) and the whole team is completely professional.
They are just genuinely so lovely, kind and happy to see me, and I will continue to return should I need any more work in the future.
Thanks guys 🫰

The only dental clinic I would travel thousands of miles to visit. Genuine, intelligent care. Aesthetically outstanding. Intuitive and welcoming. The prices and services are unmatched. Do not hesitate to make Sea Smile the best choice for your dental services.

Very disappointing experience. I paid a higher price, which I was prepared for, but the treatment was of no real value.

I was encouraged to take X-rays without being informed that no dentist was available until several days later, making them completely useless during my visit.

The cleaning was done without any proper examination by a dentist, which is unacceptable—especially for someone with veneers and bridges.

Lack of transparency and professionalism. Definitely not recommended.

The team at Sea Side dental clinic in Patong are fantastic. Had a root canal with and barely felt the work done. If anyone is nervous or hesitant, dont be. The team are great and the results were outstanding. Highly recommend
Amazing service, cannot recommend these dentists enough. My husband and I had several crowns and root fillings done. No pain, such gentle dentists, very caring.

So happy with my experience here, everything was perfect from start to finish, i was taken care of from the moment i walked in the door by the lovely receptionist kate who made sure i was happy with everything before starting. My dentist J was amazing, he informed me of everything he was going to do and made sure i understood and i was happy. I had a lot of fillings done by him and his team and they worked tirelessly on me for 2-3 hours ensuring i was comfortable and not in any pain. Their work was really good and im so happy i chose this clinic. I highly recommend this clinic.
Thank you sea smile dental clinic, i will be back !

Thankyou for your email .
I would like to share with you some constructive criticism with the service I was given today.
Firstly I think your dentist was not very gentle or considerate of patients feelings she was rough and quick undoing the clean I did not get offered any protective glasses the chair was very uncomfortable and I nearly choked during the session and very difficult to breath . My session took no more than 15 minutes and very rushed I think you need to slow down your cleaning procedure in future and make the patient feel comfortable and safe not anxious and terrified of chocking not all of us can breath through our noses , this was a terrifying experience for me and will not recommend your clinic to anyone in the future. Charging 2000 for fifteen minutes is an exaggeration whilst my wife being Thai who was in
Your care for nearly 30 minutes was charged 1500.
Regards
Eugene Spanti
By the way your reception staff were professional and nice

Prices are affordable. Perfect workmanship.  Strongly recommended to anyone without hesitation. Sea Smile Dental Clinic was the best place I could hope to receive treatment and professional advice. For which I am very grateful.

My husband and I have had extensive dental work carried out here at Seasmile Patong  Beach. Their customer service is second to none and their dental care is extraordinary!! Thankyou so much Seasmile.

The staff are extremely helpful and so lovely to deal with. We received excellent care during our visits and are very happy with the standard of work. Would recommend to come here! Thank you so much to all the ladies xxxx

Really great experience at Sea Smile Dental Clinic. Appreciated the ease of booking and finding appointment the next day, and the friendly and reassuring reception staff who is lovely and put me at ease straight away). he also explained things to me in a helpful way that I could understand. My only regret is not going there sooner!

I went for the zoom whitening and I am so happy with the result. They cleaned teeth first and must say it was the best clean I’ve had. Would definitely recommend the zoom whitening though my teeth look so white and clean. Thank you. 🙏 …
Excellent service! Got braces here, and the entire process has been great. Friendly staff and clean clinic.
Great teeth whitening by Sea Smile Phuket. Very happy with results

I couldn’t be happier with my experience—this incredible doctor gave me the perfect smile I’ve always dreamed of. The clinic itself is beautiful, with a warm and welcoming team that made me feel at home from the moment I walked in. I will be planning to return to Thailand just to relive this amazing care.

My dentist truly has the golden hands of a surgeon. I didn’t even feel the anesthesia being injected, and every step of the procedure was flawless. The entire team worked in perfect harmony—six hands at once, ensuring I was completely comfortable and that every detail was handled with precision.

The call center was also exceptional—they made sure all my requests were taken care of, and I received every appointment and service right on time. Their coordination was seamless and reassuring. Before my travel I spoke to the team though email and they made sure to analyze pictures I sent and consult with doctor and provide prices for me.

I left absolutely thrilled, smiling confidently with results that exceeded my expectations. They even provided me with a night guard that I adore—it’s incredibly comfortable and fits like a dream. And of course the prices are great , they did not charge me for anything extra and even gave me additional things for the aftercare.

If you’re considering dental travel and still on the fence, don’t hesitate. The professionalism here is unmatched. This clinic is fast, highly skilled, and genuinely exceptional. I’m beyond grateful for the care I received. Thank you Sea Smile Team !!!!
Got a crown for a fraction of a price in australia. The dentist is professional and the ladies at the front desk they are lovely. Thank u❤️

This has been another amazing dental experience here at Sea Smiles. I work in healthcare in Australia and can highly recommend the high standards and professionalism offered. Their work standards are excellent and the friendliness plus efficiency is above what I expected. Exceptional and thank you. Our teeth are back to health and give both my husband and I smiles to display with confidence. Highly recommended.

Excellent experience so far with Dr Thitima Navasjuljinda.   She is extremely experienced, flexible when plans changed, well connected with other dental specialists if you need them, and very time efficient . She was prepared to and did work overtime to meet my tight schedule.   She also was not threatened by my millions of questions about my treatment and answered them calmly and confidently ( another specialist and been put off by my inquiry about the details of my procedure as I was advised it’s not a Thai thing).

Although we have an interim result, and I will need to return, I already have white teeth and a radically improved bite I am happy with. Thank you Dr!

I am very grateful and unreservedly recommend her to anyone especially other expats who wish for high quality dental care !

Thank you !

Kala

After many years of having my teeth as an insecurity, i finally got them fixed and Sea Smile Dental, the ladies here so lovely and helpful and the Dentist explained every slowly and clearly for me to understand every 10/10 would recommend.

I have come back to Sea Smile after 15 years ago getting 2 x veneers fitted from Bangkok Smile. I never had a problem with veneers but wanted to upgrade to 4 crowns and 2 veneers.  I am extremely happy with my results. Everyone was very professional and offered the best advice before crowns and veneers were fitted. It is very clean and the dentists are very gentle and know what they are doing. You will not be disappointed the quality and expertise is extremely high. I will definitely be back if I need anymore work. Thank you Sea Smile.

I had an excellent experience at Sea Smile Dental. From the moment I walked in, the reception staff made me feel completely easy. They were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and guided me through every step of the process with genuine care and professionalism.

The dental team is top-notch — highly skilled, attentive, and gentle. I felt confident and comfortable throughout my treatment, and the results were even better than I had hoped for. The clinic is modern, clean, and very well-organized, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free.

I highly recommend Sea Smile Dental to anyone looking for high-quality dental care with a personal touch. They truly go above and beyond!
I’ve been visiting Sea. Smile for 15 years. You can’t beat the service and quality of dental work. Highly recommend.
Visited the clinic in Phuket to get veneers, clinic was very clean dentist was so professional English was fantastic understood everything I asked for highly recommend

Excellent. I had two zirconia crowns placed on my front 2 teeth - both of which had root canal many years ago which meant the procedure was risky. Dr Pimjai was my dentist and made sure I was happy with the look and feel and also fixed some small unrelated issues I had on surrounding teeth. I can strongly recommend her for anyone needing work doing, and feel immensely appreciative of her work. Thank you khap 🙏
Had a cleaning and Zoom whitening, the doctor was very nice and adviced me wich whitening i should do, during the process i feelt very comfy and i'm very happy with de result!

Our visits to Sea Smile International were a fantastic experience. I had the surgery for two dental implants, and my partner had a lazer whitening and also three Zirconia crowns done. The professionalism of the whole team at the practice …
I could not be happier with the professional team at Sea Smile International. Very welcoming exceptionally proficient and will be spreading the word. Thank you

Lovely dentists and staff here at Sea Smile. Very happy with my results and follow up care. I only wish I had more time and money to be able to do have more work done here. Definitely recommend if you are looking for dental work while in Thailand. Worth a 5 star review.

I booked an emergency appointment for a painful wisdom tooth. I was able to book that same day. professional and explained all of my options (and I was able to make my own decision).  The follow up care was very good. The receptionist  was also very  the  I am very pleased that I went to Sea Smile Dental Clinic. Thank you so much to all of the staff.

Good dental clinic in Patong Beach area , although the prices are a bit high but worth it.
Starting from reservation with excellent follow up till you complete your treatment
And they show you what plans will suit your situation and you decide which plan to choose
The dentist was very professional and efficient. The whole process was smooth and comfortable🥰 …

Where to start with my less than pleasant experience with this dentist at their Phuket location 🤔

1- The 2× appointments I attended where both over ½hr late from the original scheduled time.
2-  I was charged 3800THB for a few X-rays which I was told in a previous email chain that they were to be refunded .. regardless if they would or not 140$cdn is expensive for X-ray even at Canadian rates 🤯
3- Then the rude dentist could not clearly explain to me what was involved with the procedure and the time / number of appointment that it would involved. As I had to keep asking questions to clarify my confusion the dentist got impatient & ruder .. then when it was time to sign off their estimate the dentist called me DIRTY for licking my fingers to turn the pages 😬
4- Coming from a less than perfectly clean clinic, I sure wasn't expectinf this type of rude comment  ... I've took the freedom of joining some pictures I've taken of their mouth washing unit in which you'll clearly notice the Algae within the water feed line that they use to clean YOUR mouth 😳

Feel free to check it out but hopefully this reviews saves you from wasting as much holidays as I did with that dentist office. Needless to say I won't be getting any treatment with this clinic 😕
